topic: pay off credit card debt efficiently
core_question: What's the most efficient way to pay off multiple credit card balances?
answer_summary: Pay the minimum on all cards, then put extra money toward either the highest-interest-rate balance first (avalanche method, saves the most money) or the smallest balance first (snowball method, builds momentum), repeating until each card is paid off.
